sampling.start_policy: soft identity balance; unused node starts; marginal attribute feedback; residual edge support
sampling.axis_policy: legal identity=2/other=1; whole-history 0.5**n; global count feedback
sampling.core_coverage_override_policy: For missing changed-in core values, lock a genuine directed wardrobe edge as round one of an existing fixed job; prioritize scarce incoming support, low reuse, and new-core gain. Kind, length, fork round and fork source remain unchanged. This is explicit coverage sampling, not pure random selection.
sampling.reuse_note: Reuse below two can result from coverage, zero/one-use preference, fixed fork jobs, and local graph support; no missing edge is invented to raise reuse.
